description: This file defines traits and objects related to filtering Spark events for the Spark History Server, including the EventFilter trait, FilterStatistics, and the applyFilterToFile method for processing event log files.

classes.name: FilterStatistics
classes.description: Holds statistical data about total and live jobs, stages, and tasks for filtering purposes.

methods.name: createFilter
methods.description: Creates a new EventFilter instance based on the builder.

methods.name: statistics
methods.description: Returns statistical information used for measuring filter effectiveness.

methods.name: acceptFn
methods.description: Returns a partial function to classify events as accepted or rejected.

methods.name: applyFilterToFile
methods.description: Reads an event log file and applies a sequence of filters, invoking callbacks based on event acceptance or rejection.
